title: Software Engineer Intern - Summer 2027
description:
Orchard Streaming is looking for interns for Summer 2027.

What you will do:
- Build services in Java and Python that serve members.
- Work with a mentor on a real project.

Who you are:
- Currently pursuing a BS or MS in Computer Science, graduating between December 2027 and June 2028.
